gridley player 5956 = afldb 10673: Gridley lists, AFLDB omits (missing from pickrookie); an independent source confirms a Rookie Draft selection DraftGuru's linked page omits (AFLDB-ISSUE-222 §11.19.13 D2): pick 3 (Greater Western Sydney, 2022); Rookie Me Central pick-by-pick 2022 AFL Rookie Draft: 'Pick 3 (GWS) - Phil Davis*' (re-listed), corroborated by the site's separate GWS 2022 draft review naming him '#3 Phil Davis (re-listed)'. gridley player 6501 = afldb 11672: Gridley lists, AFLDB omits (missing from pickrookie); an independent source confirms a Rookie Draft selection DraftGuru's linked page omits (AFLDB-ISSUE-222 §11.19.13 D2): pick 11 (Sydney, 2023); afl.com.au 'Luckless Sydney Swans tall Sam Reid to return to training after rookie draft': 'Reid was selected at pick No.11 in the Rookie Draft with Sydney...'. Held in the 2023 draft period for the 2024 season (Wikipedia's infobox labels the section '2024 rookie draft'). This is the Sydney forward born 1991, not GWS's Sam Reid (born 1989).

gridley player 5307 = afldb 9575: Gridley lists, AFLDB omits (missing from pickrookie); an independent source confirms a Rookie Draft selection DraftGuru's linked page omits (AFLDB-ISSUE-222 §11.19.13 D2): pick 2 (Gold Coast, 2018); goldcoastfc.com.au 'Rischitelli to play on in 2019' (primary club source): 'Rischitelli will continue his career as a Rookie listed player, with the GC SUNS committing to select Rischitelli at the NAB AFL Rookie Draft on Friday 23rd November [2018]', no pick number given. Wikipedia's '2019 AFL rookie draft' page (season-labelled) lists him as the first round's second selection, pick 2; the pick number is sourced from Wikipedia only.

gridley player 1319 = afldb 2443: Gridley lists, AFLDB omits (missing from pickrookie); an independent source confirms a Rookie Draft selection DraftGuru's linked page omits (AFLDB-ISSUE-222 §11.19.13 D2): pick 1 (Adelaide, 2020); Zero Hanger (citing The Age's Daniel Cherny, 10 Dec 2020) 'Crows to re-draft Bryce Gibbs with Pick 1 in rookie draft': Adelaide took Gibbs with rookie pick 1 purely for salary-cap/administrative purposes for the 2021 season; he remained retired and did not play. No primary AFL/Crows article naming the pick was found; weaker secondary evidence, corroborated by general reporting of the same event.
